verdict.rationale: MailerSend documents its own rule-based automation for one event type: incoming emails are automatically parsed and routed using rules and webhooks. Webhooks also push real-time event notifications with retries, but that is outbound notification, not a user-defined rule engine for arbitrary events. Missing for 10: a general event-to-action rule or workflow builder beyond inbound routing, documentation of rule conditions and action types, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Automatically parse and route incoming emails using rules and webhooks.
Webhooks allow you to subscribe to real-time notifications about various events that occur in MailerSend.
